gloss: start of winter; first day of winter

definitions.gloss: start of winter; first day of winter
definitions.explanation: one of the 24 solar terms ({二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}) in the traditional East Asian calendar, marking the beginning of winter, usually falling around November 7-8

examples.japanese: {立冬|りっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{朝晩|あさばん}→朝晩：28955_asaban⟧⟦{冷|ひ}え{込|こ}む→冷え込む：11727_hiekomu⟧。
examples.english: After the start of winter, mornings and evenings become quite cold.

examples.japanese: {立冬|りっとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鍋料理|なべりょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{我|わ}が{家|や}→我が家：03038_wagaya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恒例|こうれい}→恒例：12597_kourei⟧だ。
examples.english: Eating hot pot on the first day of winter is a tradition in our family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立冬|りっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: On the calendar we've reached the start of winter, but this year warm days still continue.

notes:
One of the ⟦{二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}→二十四節気：25146_nijuushisekki⟧ (24 solar terms). Falls around November 7-8, marking the calendrical start of winter. Like ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧, the actual weather may not yet feel wintry at this time. The phrase ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (according to the calendar) is often used to acknowledge the gap between the calendar date and actual weather.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立冬|りっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach the start of winter
- {立冬|りっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass the start of winter
- {立冬|りっとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}: seasonal greeting phrase for this time of year
- ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立冬|りっとう}: calendrically it is the start of winter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立春|りっしゅん}→立春：22417_risshun⟧: start of spring (around February 4)
- ⟦{立夏|りっか}→立夏：20374_rikka⟧: start of summer (around May 6)
- ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧: start of autumn (around August 7)
- ⟦{冬至|とうじ}→冬至：11756_touji⟧: winter solstice — the shortest day of the year, distinct from the start of winter
